tail.content: why does the incidents list only have Previous and Next? no page numbers

Because it pages by keyset: each page only knows where the next one starts (the cursor in `next`), not how many pages there are or where page 7 begins. The comment in incidents.ts gives the reason: deep OFFSET pages ran into the 5s statement timeout. Previous works by remembering the cursors of the pages you've already seen.
page numbers would be nicer for finding older incidents though
They would. Keyset paging trades that for pages that stay fast however far back you go.

topic_probes.text: switch the incidents list back to the primary then, during an outage I need new incidents to show up immediately

tail.content: do new incidents show up right away in the incidents list?

src/server/incidents.ts:1:import { replica } from './db';
src/server/incidents.ts:30:  const { rows } = await replica.query(pageQuery(cursor, limit));
Not always. The list reads from the replica, which trails the primary, so an incident opened a moment ago can be missing until you reload.
that's not great in the middle of an outage
It's a trade-off: reading from the replica keeps the list's queries off the primary, at the cost of being slightly behind it.
